info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Guideline Compliance Operational Action-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the submission of operational actions related to guideline compliance within the banking sector. Businesses can utilize this endpoint to initiate new compliance actions, ensuring adherence to regulatory standards and operational protocols. Typical users include compliance officers, regulatory teams, and banking administrators who manage compliance workflows. By streamlining the process of creating operational actions, this API supports efficient compliance management and reduces the risk of non-compliance.

post.summary: Create a new operational action for guideline compliance.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new operational action that complies with the established guidelines. Ensure that all required fields are included in the request to successfully create the action.
